Akristofoɔ abrabɔ
1 # 1 Pe 2.13 Kae wɔn na wɔmmrɛ wɔn ho ase mma mpaninnie ne tumi ahodoɔ no, wɔnyɛ setie, wɔnsiesie wɔn ho mma adwuma pa biara, 2#Flp 4.5 wɔnnni obiara ho nsekuro, wɔnnyɛ atutupɛfoɔ; wɔwɔ abodwokyɛre, na wɔnyi ɔdwoɔ nyinaa adi nkyerɛ nnipa nyinaa.
3 # 1 Ko 6.11; Efe 2.2; 5.8 Ɛfiri sɛ yɛn nso, akane no na yɛyɛ nkwasea, asoɔdenfoɔ, nnipa a wɔtaa yɛ mfomsoɔ, som akɔnnɔ ne anigyedeɛ ahodoɔ, te nnebɔne ne nitan mu a wɔn ho yɛ ahi na wɔtentane wɔn ho wɔn ho. 4#Tito 2.11 Na yɛn Agyenkwa Nyankopɔn adɔeɛ ne ne dɔ yii ne ho adie no, 5#Efe 2.8-9; Yoh 3.5; Efe 5.26 ɛmfiri tenenee mu nnwuma a yɛayɛ mu, na mmom ɔno ara ne mmɔborɔhunu nti, na ɛmaa no faa awo foforɔ adwareɛ ne Honhom Kronkron foforɔyɛ so gyee yɛn nkwa. 6#Yoel 2.28 Ɛno na ɔnam yɛn Agyenkwa Yesu Kristo so hwie guu yɛn so pii, 7na wɔnam n’adom so abu yɛn bem ama yɛayɛ daa nkwa no anidasoɔ ho adedifoɔ. 8#Tito 3.14 Ɛyɛ nokwasɛm, na yeinom na mehwɛ sɛ wohyɛ mu den, na wɔn a wɔagye Onyankopɔn adie no adwene sɛdeɛ wɔbɛbɔ nnwuma pa ho mmɔden. Yeinom ne deɛ ɛyɛ fɛ na ɛyɛ mfasoɔ ma onipa. 9#1 Ti 4.7 Na nkwasea akyinnyegyeɛ ne anatoɔ ne kunsunkunsum ne mmara ho akasakasa deɛ, twe wo ho firi ho; ɛfiri sɛ ɛnyɛ mma hwee, na ɛyɛ hunu. 10#2 Yoh 10; Mat 18.15-16 Onipa a ɔde mpaepaemu ba, a woakasa akyerɛ no prɛko ne ne mprenu no, pa no! 11#1 Ti 6.4-5 Na hunu sɛ, deɛ ɔte saa no, ne tiri asɛe, na ɔyɛ bɔne bu ɔno ara ne ho fɔ wɔ mu.
Nkradie ne nhyira nsɛm
12 # 2 Ti 4.12 Sɛ mesoma Artema anaa Tihiko wɔ wo nkyɛn a, bɔ mmɔden bra me nkyɛn wɔ Nikopoli, na ɛhɔ na mabɔ me tirim sɛ merekɔdi awɔ berɛ. 13#Aso 18.24; 1 Ko 3.5-6 Bɔ mmɔden gya Mmaranimfoɔ Sena ne Apolo kwan yie, na anhia wɔn hwee. 14#Tito 2.14; Efe 4.28; Mat 7.19 Na ma yɛn nkurɔfoɔ no nsua nnwuma pa ho mmɔdemmɔ nso mfa mmoa wɔn a ɛhia wɔn, na aba pa ammɔ wɔn.
15Wɔn a wɔne me wɔ ha nyinaa kyeakyea wo. Kyeakyea wɔn a wɔdɔ yɛn wɔ gyidie no mu. Adom nka mo nyinaa.

pageProps.chapterText:
Kae wɔn na wɔmmrɛ wɔn ho ase mma mpaninnie ne tumi ahodoɔ no, wɔnyɛ setie, wɔnsiesie wɔn ho mma adwuma pa biara, wɔnnni obiara ho nsekuro, wɔnnyɛ atutupɛfoɔ; wɔwɔ abodwokyɛre, na wɔnyi ɔdwoɔ nyinaa adi nkyerɛ nnipa nyinaa.
Ɛfiri sɛ yɛn nso, akane no na yɛyɛ nkwasea, asoɔdenfoɔ, nnipa a wɔtaa yɛ mfomsoɔ, som akɔnnɔ ne anigyedeɛ ahodoɔ, te nnebɔne ne nitan mu a wɔn ho yɛ ahi na wɔtentane wɔn ho wɔn ho. Na yɛn Agyenkwa Nyankopɔn adɔeɛ ne ne dɔ yii ne ho adie no, ɛmfiri tenenee mu nnwuma a yɛayɛ mu, na mmom ɔno ara ne mmɔborɔhunu nti, na ɛmaa no faa awo foforɔ adwareɛ ne Honhom Kronkron foforɔyɛ so gyee yɛn nkwa. Ɛno na ɔnam yɛn Agyenkwa Yesu Kristo so hwie guu yɛn so pii, na wɔnam n’adom so abu yɛn bem ama yɛayɛ daa nkwa no anidasoɔ ho adedifoɔ. Ɛyɛ nokwasɛm, na yeinom na mehwɛ sɛ wohyɛ mu den, na wɔn a wɔagye Onyankopɔn adie no adwene sɛdeɛ wɔbɛbɔ nnwuma pa ho mmɔden. Yeinom ne deɛ ɛyɛ fɛ na ɛyɛ mfasoɔ ma onipa. Na nkwasea akyinnyegyeɛ ne anatoɔ ne kunsunkunsum ne mmara ho akasakasa deɛ, twe wo ho firi ho; ɛfiri sɛ ɛnyɛ mma hwee, na ɛyɛ hunu. Onipa a ɔde mpaepaemu ba, a woakasa akyerɛ no prɛko ne ne mprenu no, pa no! Na hunu sɛ, deɛ ɔte saa no, ne tiri asɛe, na ɔyɛ bɔne bu ɔno ara ne ho fɔ wɔ mu.

Sɛ mesoma Artema anaa Tihiko wɔ wo nkyɛn a, bɔ mmɔden bra me nkyɛn wɔ Nikopoli, na ɛhɔ na mabɔ me tirim sɛ merekɔdi awɔ berɛ. Bɔ mmɔden gya Mmaranimfoɔ Sena ne Apolo kwan yie, na anhia wɔn hwee. Na ma yɛn nkurɔfoɔ no nsua nnwuma pa ho mmɔdemmɔ nso mfa mmoa wɔn a ɛhia wɔn, na aba pa ammɔ wɔn.
Wɔn a wɔne me wɔ ha nyinaa kyeakyea wo. Kyeakyea wɔn a wɔdɔ yɛn wɔ gyidie no mu. Adom nka mo nyinaa.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
